title: Cooking or Clicking: The Impact of Online Food Delivery Platforms on Domestic Food Preparation
eligible_reason: Every regression enters two simultaneous binary treatments (grubhub_presence = Grubhub aggregator available in the county, grubhubdelivery = Grubhub delivery available) together with individual-level covariates (faminc_thous, hh_size, hh_numkids, sex, age, employed, race) and county-level time-varying controls (unemployment, ln_pop, ln_est), with ATUS probability weights (pweight wt06 / wt_mod) and county + state x year FE. The protocol excludes additional treatments and time-varying controls; there is no column with a single treatment and no controls. The did2s check (Table A12) also conditions on the full control set and is in the appendix. Table 4 is a fixed-effects logit hazard; BRFSS Table 8 adds MSA-level time-varying controls and demographic FE.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe, svy sdr, cem, did2s) in FirstLook/stata_code.do; R (fixest::feols) in survey_and_figures.Rmd for figures. Data: ATUS respondent-level repeated cross-section 2005-2019 in 230 counties (stata_file1.csv ... stata_file9.csv), BRFSS SMART MSA data (stata_file5.csv). Treatment timing: Grubhub county entry (phased 2005-2019; deliveryentry year). Table 2: food_prep ~ grubhub_presence grubhubdelivery + controls [pw=wt06], absorb(county state#year), cluster(county); columns with CEM-matched samples and SDR replicate-weight SEs. Tables 3, 5, 7: other time-use outcomes with the same structure. Table A7: relative-time dummies (rt_year_dummy) with controls. Table A9 placebo. Table A12: did2s with first_stage(controls) second_stage(i.grubhub_presence i.grubhubdelivery).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Grubhub entered counties in phases 2005-2019 (many cohorts), but data are not in the package to count them.
modern_estimators_named: did2s (Gardner two-stage), Table A12, with covariates in first stage

specs.exclusion_reason: two treatments (grubhub_presence, grubhubdelivery) + individual and county time-varying controls + pweights
specs.treatment_definition: county-year indicators for Grubhub aggregator presence and Grubhub delivery availability
specs.controls: faminc_thous hh_size hh_numkids sex age unemployment ln_pop ln_est ib2.employed i.race
specs.notes: Columns 1-4 use full sample / CEM-matched samples; column 6 SDR SEs.

specs.exclusion_reason: appendix; did2s with covariates in first stage; two treatments
specs.treatment_var: grubhubdelivery (treatment()), with i.grubhub_presence i.grubhubdelivery in second stage

data_access: public (ATUS/IPUMS, BRFSS SMART, Census) but the merged CSVs are hosted externally (https://tinyurl.com/MSINS202302636), not in the package
screener_notes: Package folder FirstLook/ contains code, readme (rtf), output tables (grubhub_tables.rtf) and figures; the rtf tables could supply published coefficients if ever needed.
